flow_scenarios: Neutral (0V signal region near mid-band, spool centered): open-center path connects P to T directly through spool bore; no flow to A or B; LS line stays at tank/low pressure since no work port pressurized.

Signal <5V (to STBD): spool shifts to connect P -> A port; B port connects to T return; oil flows out A to bow thruster motor driving STBD rotation; return oil from motor B line flows back through spool to T rail; LS_A line senses A-branch pressure and is capped by its 250 bar limiter.
Signal >5V (to PORT): spool shifts opposite way, P -> B port, A -> T; oil drives thruster to PORT direction; LS_B line senses B-branch pressure, capped by its 250 bar limiter.

Over-pressure on A: if A work-port pressure exceeds 280 bar, the A-side 157B2280 relief opens and dumps A flow to the common return/T rail, protecting the actuator/line from over-pressure regardless of spool position.
Over-pressure on B: symmetric case — B-side 157B2280 relief opens at 280 bar to T rail when B pressure exceeds setting.
M-line protection: pressure on the M (case-drain/auxiliary) line is limited to 300 bar by the relief/check pair before joining the common M/P/T rail at the bottom of the module.

composition.serve_who: This sheet ("FWD BLOCK B: DANFOSS PVG 32/16 – 3 FUNCTIONS") is the FWD hydraulic manifold block B, hosting three named function slices: BOW THRUSTER (EV-2.1, PVG32 module), B.T. UP/DOWN (EV-2.2, PVG16 module) and B.T. LOCK (EV-2.3, PVG16 module). All three slices are explicitly labelled "B.T." (Bow Thruster) sub-functions and therefore all serve the same equipment: the bow thruster system (460-bow-thruster-oms-h300), which per the register/mappings covers bow thruster drive, lift and lock functions. The manifold block itself (inlet/end section with M/LS/P/T rails, the standalone reduced-pressure valve, and shared rails) is infrastructure belonging to the FWD blockB manifold node (570-danfoss-pvg-32-16-fwd-blockb), not to the bow thruster equipment node.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: All three slices on this sheet are labelled with 'BOW THRUSTER' / 'B.T.' prefixes, matching the engineer-confirmed mapping of bow thruster (drive), bow thruster lift/up-down and bow thruster lock all to node 460-bow-thruster-oms-h300. This is consistent with the established schematic facts already on that node (spool 65 lt/min, PVEU 0-10V, same cartridge family 11166832/15785111/etc.) from the same file family (FWD_blockB.pdf).

functions.label: BOW THRUSTER — proportional drive
functions.what_it_does: Proportionally drives the bow thruster motor to STBD or PORT, metering flow in proportion to a 0-10V electrical signal from the pilot module; open-center spool so pump flow bypasses to tank when no command is present.
key_components: Main proportional directional spool (open-center, PVG32 main stage)
Pilot/shuttle module directing the spool from the 0-10V signal
Load-sense pressure limiters on LS_A and LS_B branches
M-line (case/auxiliary) relief and check pair upstream of the shared M/P/T rail

flow_scenarios.path: P flows through the open-center spool directly to T; no directed flow to A or B; LS stays unloaded at tank pressure.

Spool shifts, P → port A → bow thruster motor drives STBD; return flow from motor via port B → spool → T; LS_A senses A-branch pressure, capped by its load-sense limiter (set per drawing, ~250 bar per prior read).
Spool shifts opposite way, P → port B → motor drives PORT; return from A → spool → T; LS_B senses B-branch pressure, capped by its load-sense limiter.
If A work-port pressure exceeds the A-side relief setting (280 bar), the relief opens and dumps A flow to the common T return, protecting the actuator/lines independent of spool position.
Symmetric: B-side relief opens at 280 bar to T when B pressure exceeds setting.

functions.dry_data: PVG32 module, spool 65 lt/min, PVEU proportional actuation 0-10V (threshold 5V splits STBD/PORT), open neutral (open-center) position.

functions.label: B.T. UP/DOWN — lift/lower actuation
functions.what_it_does: Raises or lowers the bow thruster unit (lift function) via ON/OFF solenoid-piloted spool; closed-center at neutral so the thruster lift cylinder holds position with no drift when not commanded.
key_components: Work-port relief/anti-cavitation element on A side
Work-port relief valve on B side

flow_scenarios.path: Spool closed-center; no flow to A or B; pump flow bypasses to the tank return rail; lift cylinder holds its position.
Pilot solenoid shifts spool, P → port A → lift cylinder extends/raises the thruster; return oil from B → spool → tank rail.
Pilot solenoid shifts spool opposite way, P → port B → lift cylinder retracts/lowers the thruster; return oil from A → spool → tank rail.
If B-port pressure exceeds the relief setting, the relief cartridge opens and dumps excess flow to the tank return rail.

functions.dry_data: PVG16 module, spool 5 lt/min, PVEO ON/OFF actuation; UP=A / DOWN=B; closed neutral position.

functions.label: B.T. LOCK — thruster lock cylinder
functions.what_it_does: Extends/retracts the bow thruster mechanical lock cylinder (IN/OUT) via ON/OFF solenoid-piloted spool; closed-center holds the lock in its last commanded position when de-energized.
key_components: Restrictor/check element on the A-side branch (function not fully legible)

flow_scenarios.path: Spool centered/closed; P blocked from both A and B; lock cylinder held in place (closed-center holds load, neither locking nor unlocking).
P → spool → port A → lock cylinder strokes IN (locks the thruster); opposite port B routed to tank return.
P → spool → port B → lock cylinder strokes OUT (unlocks the thruster); opposite port A routed to tank return.

functions.dry_data: PVG16 module, spool 5 lt/min, PVEO ON/OFF actuation; IN=A / OUT=B; closed neutral position.

infrastructure.system_name: Danfoss PVG 32/16 FWD Block B manifold (inlet/end section, rails)
facts: Block hosts 3 function slices (EV-2.1 BOW THRUSTER, EV-2.2 B.T. UP/DOWN, EV-2.3 B.T. LOCK) sharing common P (pressure), T (tank/return), M, LS, LS_A and LS_B rails running the full width of the sheet.

Inlet/end section at left includes a standalone reduced-pressure valve supplying SPOOL CONTROL (pilot) pressure to the slices, plus an M-line relief/check network venting to the T rail; a load-sense limiter cartridge set to 300 bar caps LS branch pressure with a downstream damping orifice before the T rail.

A red warning-triangle revision marker sits near the M-line block-level component and near the '95' relief on EV-2.2's B port, and on the pilot modules of EV-2.2/EV-2.3 — per the revision table these correspond to rev. changes on this file (rev 10: 'PROPORTIONAL AFT WINCHES' etc. do not directly match FWD blockB, so the specific triggering revision row for this sheet's markers could not be tied to a line item; flagged as uncertainty).
P, T, M, LS rails continue off-sheet to left/right, consistent with a shared FWD manifold gallery serving multiple function blocks (block A/B) — cross-block continuity, not this equipment's own line.

cross_references.what: Continuation of the shared P/T/M/LS rails to the left edge (labelled 157B5111, 157B2014) and right edge, feeding/joining the adjacent FWD block A manifold section
Bow thruster motor and lock cylinder actuator hardware itself (only hydraulic supply/control shown here, actuator drawn off-sheet)

cross_references.what: PLC/electrical control wiring for the PVEU (0-10V) and PVEO (ON/OFF) pilot signals driving EV-2.1/2.2/2.3
cross_references.referenced_sheet_hint: electrical schematics / PLC I/O rack sheet (e.g. 570-plc-rack-er or similar hydraulic control rack)

good_to_have: Exact bar values of the EV-2.1 work-port reliefs (280 bar each side, per legend) and LS limiters (~250 bar) — legible on drawing at inspection
M-line relief setting (~300 bar) at block inlet — spool control/pilot pressure valve
Exact bar value of the '95' marked relief on EV-2.2 port B — value present on drawing, read at inspection

Cartridge/part numbers (11166832, 11166838, 157B5111, 157B6233, 157B2280, 157B7123, 11130982, 157B2014, 11105532) are stamped on the sheet but not needed to understand function; capture at inspection if ever required
